result.reason: The file satisfies every criterion in the specification: it exports exactly one `run` function with the Store first and a single input object returning Result<Review>; the module name is verb-first kebab-case (`create-review.ts`); domain failures are returned as values with consumer-oriented error messages naming what was wrong and what is accepted; input validation happens before any work and reads top-to-bottom; the service does one thing; no I/O occurs except through the injected Store; and the doc comment states the purpose in one sentence and enumerates all domain failure modes (unknown parlor id, rating outside 1-5 or non-integer, empty author, short tasting notes).
